entries.mitigation: Kill and control Fleshspawn before they combine into a Flesh Abomination. Do not let small adds sit unattended during the portal cycle.
entries.notes: ESO-Hub's Flesh Swarmed achievement confirms Fleshspawn can form a Flesh Abomination; raid guides treat preventing merges as the normal handling goal.

entries.mitigation: Send the assigned portal team, kill the Channeler, use Carrion Shields to reset Caustic Carrion pressure, and be ready for Harvester/Abomination pressure on return.
entries.notes: Reviewed achievement and raid-guide evidence support Channeler priority, Caustic Carrion management, and post-portal add pressure.

entries.mitigation: Treat Sparking and Blazing Heat Rays as unblockable. Follow your color/assignment and do not rely on block to save the hit.
entries.notes: PTS v11.0.4 explicitly states Sparking and Blazing Heat Ray are unblockable.

entries.entry_name: Sparking Blazing Enfeeblement — Jynorah and Skorkhif
entries.mitigation: Keep your assigned elemental side and portal responsibility straight through deaths and clash phases; HM strategy depends on maintaining the correct color assignment.
entries.notes: Reviewed achievement and addon documentation support color-based Enfeeblement assignments in HM.

entries.mitigation: Kite the Surge away from the stack when targeted and return once the mechanic resolves.
entries.notes: Current Ossein Cage helper documentation identifies Seeking Surges as a kite mechanic.

entries.mitigation: Kill Jynorah and Skorkhif together. Once the first boss dies, finish the other within 15 seconds or the survivor wipes the group.
entries.notes: Wondernuts' veteran/HM guide documents the 15-second kill window.

entries.mitigation: Take the bomb away from the group. The achievement condition is explicit: only the initial target should be hit by the explosion.
entries.notes: ESO-Hub Avoiding Agony achievement directly states the initial target should be the only player hit.

entries.mitigation: The two tethered players create safe distance, then use the Giant Sword to break the chain without clipping teammates with the tether line.
entries.notes: Reviewed raid-guide and addon evidence support two-player tether handling, distance states, and using the sword to sever the chain.

entries.mitigation: Respect the active Biting Blaze areas and do not assume a new cast can overlap indefinitely; the current rule prevents Kazpian from recasting before the previous Biting Blaze expires.
entries.notes: Update 48 Incremental 1 fixed Biting Blaze so a new cast does not occur before the prior cast expires.

entries.entry_name: Kazpian Ally Proximity Enrage — Overfiend Kazpian
entries.mitigation: Keep Kazpian separated from elite allies and side bosses. Do not stack him on them for cleave.
entries.notes: PTS v11.0.3 states Kazpian reacts aggressively when fighting near allies; current raid practice keeps them separated.
